en.headline: Hongkong Land opens 15-day Halloween carnival with installations in Central
en.dek: Four large light installations including a giant eyeball appear at Statue Square Garden from today until 31 October; most areas are free to enter.
body: Hongkong Land has opened its first large-scale Halloween event, Halloween Carnival in Central, running from 17 to 31 October across Statue Square Garden South and the Chater Road pedestrian zone.

Four themed installations are on display and free to visit: a giant eyeball rising beside the fountain, an archway at the Chater Road entrance, a coffin throne near Central MTR Station Exit K, and the pavilion reimagined as a ghostly prison. Lights operate daily from 4pm to 11:30pm, extended to 1am on 31 October.

Today’s programme includes a wellness day with pickleball sessions from 2pm to 8pm on Chater Road, open to walk-up registration. Later dates feature a ticketed music opening on 18 October and a family carnival on 24 October. Organisers said the event is supported by the Hong Kong Tourism Board and draws on Central’s historic streetscape.

zh.headline: 置地公司中環萬聖節狂歡祭今日啟動 皇后像廣場設四大裝置
zh.dek: 活動由今日至31日一連15天舉行，巨型眼球等裝置於下午四時起亮燈，大部分區域免費開放。
body: 置地公司呈獻的《萬聖狂歡祭．中環》今日起至10月31日在皇后像廣場花園（南）及遮打道行人專用區舉行，為期15天。
四大主題裝置包括噴水池旁的巨型眼球「魅影之眼」、遮打道入口的門廊「甦醒之門」、中環站K出口外的「鬼王寶座」，以及涼亭化身的「亡魂禁地」。裝置全日開放，每日下午四時至晚上十一時半亮燈，萬聖節當日延長至凌晨一時，免費入場。
今日遮打道設有「嘩鬼充電日」，下午二時至八時有匹克球等身心靈活動，接受現場報名。其後將有18日的音樂開幕祭及24日的親子嘉年華。主辦方表示活動獲旅遊發展局支持，以中環歷史街景為靈感。
